content.comment_body: I'm preparing an application based on [product_name] for my client. The client wants a simple application that allows them to upload the daily data log to their desktop by clicking a button, getting the current data log as a .csv file. Using [product_name] tools or the transfer/upload workflow from [product_name] programming software is not acceptable; it must be a standalone application. As far as I know, downloading the data log through the built-in web server isn't supported. Is such a tool available, or could it be created with open-source libraries like snap7?

Based on your requirements, I am not aware of any ready-made tool for this purpose—you would need to program it yourself. To read out the data log, you not only need to handle the readout process, but the [product_name] device must first be set to STOP mode, then you can read the data log and afterwards restart the device. Using this approach, only the current data log can be accessed. If the data log is saved to an SD card, you would need to physically remove the SD card from the [product_name] device and open or copy the data on your PC.

Hello [user_name], Consider using [product_name] Access Tool and review its help documentation. With this solution, it is possible to download and save log files directly to Excel. You don't need more than Excel to automate a process to visualize events. [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are seeking a straightforward way to transfer a [product_name] data log to a desktop as a .csv file, without using the main programming environment. Existing workflows are considered overly complicated for end users, and direct access through the built-in web server is recognized as a limitation. Current alternatives involve device state changes, physical access to storage media, or programming a custom tool.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple, standalone application with one-click functionality to transfer the current data log in .csv format from the [product_name] device to their desktop.
